issue.title: Sharding + gzip: `GzipCodec::encoded_representation` under-estimates the encoded size, causing an out-of-bounds panic

fix.title: fix: gzip encoded representation bound can be exceeded, overflowing sharded buffers

fix_summary: Conservative gzip encoded-size bound and defensive shard bounds checks. Independently tested via the released crate in the standalone fixed control; no production dependency change.
